name: Entergy Corporation
monetization: Regulated Gulf-South utility; monetizes AI through rate-based new gas generation and transmission serving Meta's Hyperion campus in Richland Parish, Louisiana (~2.2GW load) under long-term electric service agreements.

observations.metric_label: New CCGT capacity being built for Meta's Hyperion load
observations.notes: Three combined-cycle gas turbines (~$3.2B) approved by the Louisiana PSC in 2025; in service 2028-2029.
